title: $33 Million a Year for Running
description:
33 million dollars in one year. For running.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Usain Bolt: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usain_Bolt

From Wikipedia (Usain Bolt): by 15 he was 1.95 metres tall and won the 200 m at the 2002 World Junior Championships in Kingston, after which he signed a sponsorship deal with Puma; his 100 m world record of 9.58 seconds (2009) still stands; in 2016 he earned about $33 million, No. 32 on Forbes' list of the world's highest-paid athletes and the only track and field athlete on it; the highest-paid athlete in the sport's history. Not financial advice.

cta: Bolt or a cheetah? Comment who wins.

scenes.narration: 33 million dollars in one year. For running.
The only track athlete on Forbes' highest-paid list.
At 15, he was already 1.95 meters tall. And he won a world junior title.
A sponsor signed him right after. Then came 9.58 seconds.
It's still the record. And no sprinter has been paid more.
